notes.FIX_BONUS: Top players' FRA draft video (2026-11-02): 'always take the land unless it's so above replacement'. FRA top-drafter train top-1 55.76 -> 56.11, test 55.87 -> 56.33 (top-3 85.79 -> 86.58); mock decks 54.58 -> 54.54 (100 fresh tables); dual lands per draft 0.28 -> 0.97. Bonus 1-6 all similar; 3 is the middle.
notes.themes: Synergy hypotheses from FRA guides, recorded 2026-11-02 for testing (tools/fit_themes.py); not applied by the engine. Patterns match lower-cased oracle text.
notes.splash_claims: Guides on splashing, to check against fitted splash/three rules: slow decks (ramp, graveyard, control) splash, aggro does not (LLU #258); 3 sources minimum, 4 ideal, scale with real fixers, basics alone do not count (LLU #258); double-pip splashes work with 7-8 sources thanks to duals, landcyclers, Murmuring Volume (State of the Format; our deck_features showed -2.0 points per double-pip splash copy); splash order: single-pip raw power, then card advantage or removal to fill gaps, then to replace filler (LLU #258); RG ramp often ends 3-5 colours (State of the Format); Heartwood makes red the easiest splash for green.

surveil.payoff: whenever you scry or surveil|scried or surveilled|whenever you surveil|surveilled this turn
surveil.claim: WU surveil: Peer Review, Fatehold Chronologist, Semester Foreseer and every empower card feed Prudent Fateseer, Surveillance Phantasm, Desperate Futurescribe, Denzilore Fatehold.
video_claims: Videos add Proctor of Potential, Denzilore Fatehold, Diviner of Victory, Fatehold Charm, Eye of Jace; WU named one of the strongest decks because its cards pull the same way.
Set reviews: surveil has the most support of any synergy in the set; Saheeli, Consul of Oversight needs a Jace token present; Surveillance Phantasm is good on turn 2 and turn 10.

jace.payoff: control a jace|jace tokens? you control|loyalty abilit|planeswalkers? you control|another planeswalker
jace.claim: UG empower: Jace tokens grow into card draw; Way of the Mind Sculptor, Tam, Kiora of Salt and Sand and Mind Meanderer pay off; Arcane Amphisbaena, Keeper of the Quiet Hour, Mindseeker Oculus enable.
sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yAsCF-NNrLs (LLU #261, Saying Goodbye to Reality Fracture, ft. Marc; transcript pasted by the user)
video_claims: Videos add Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes, Sanctum Lurker, Repurposed Enforcer, Theorist's Sanctum, Jace's Machinations, Tam's Resistance; Kiora of Salt and Sand an 'upside trap'.
LLU #261: Way of the Mind Sculptor pairs with other ways' -2+ abilities and needs some empower cards; Way of the Healer good in WU, narrow elsewhere; Jace mostly downticks once.

Set reviews: Protege's Awakening only good with ways to spend big loyalty chunks (Amphisbaena, Kiora of Salt and Sand line); Way of the Cryomancer wants 7-8 empower cards; Campus Crier empowers from the graveyard at instant speed.
State of the Format: play 3 Ways at most (one loyalty activation a turn); Way of the Healer wants 5-7 empower cards; ranking Healer > Mind Sculptor > Paradox > Wildspeaker.

graveyard.payoff: threshold|seven or more cards in your graveyard|cards in your graveyard|from your graveyard|flashback
graveyard.claim: UB threshold / BG recursion: Omit Variables, Void Extrapolator, Primal Witchstalker fill the graveyard for Recursive Recruitment, Theoretical Necromancer, Null Summoner, Rewrite Regrets.
sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yAsCF-NNrLs (LLU #261, Saying Goodbye to Reality Fracture, ft. Marc; transcript pasted by the user)
video_claims: Videos: Theorix Metamage/Charm, Void Extrapolator, Paradox Shaper mill via the prepared spell; Recursive Recruitment can be splashed in BG; Hapatra wants big cards (landcyclers are MV 6) in the graveyard; Paradox Shaper does not share a deck with threshold.

LLU #261: Omit Variables (the UB prepared spell) is close to a card's worth because so much uses the graveyard: Twinned Vision, Theoretical Necromancer (want multiples), Recursive Recruitment (flashback with two 6/6s; often rummage the front half away).
LLU #258: Something Worth Saving is the key BG enabler; one Theoretical Necromancer, two only with heavy mill; Blessed Ghoul wants 4-5 self-mill cards; Null Summoner must be cast, not reanimated.

noncombat.enabler: deals? \d+ damage to (target|each) opponent|damage to each opponent|vicious verse
noncombat.claim: BR pings: Stingerquill Voxmancer (Vicious Verse), Screeching Soulbreaker, Hallway Heckler enable Grim Repriser, Master of Barbs, Massacre Girl, Command the Stage.
sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yAsCF-NNrLs (LLU #261, Saying Goodbye to Reality Fracture, ft. Marc; transcript pasted by the user)
video_claims: Videos: Master of Barbs with Ingris Stingerquill 'game over'; cast payoffs before enablers; hosts trust BR least.
LLU #261: Command the Stage needs multiples plus Hallway Heckler; 75-80% of RB decks are midrange piles that do not want it; Vicious Verse underpowered.
Set reviews: Screeching Soulbreaker as a repeatable free trigger; Tomik, Izzet Sparkmage with Fulminous Forte; Danitha, Spear of Agony grows on Vicious Verse.

lifegain.payoff: whenever you gain life|if you gained life
lifegain.claim: WG lifegain: Blessed Ghoul, Medic's Kitesail, Seed Suture creatures trigger Bloombrute, Titanbones, Kwia Vigorbloom, Unflinching Hortimancer, Lyra.
sources: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yAsCF-NNrLs (LLU #261, Saying Goodbye to Reality Fracture, ft. Marc; transcript pasted by the user)
video_claims: Videos: Germinate Recruits (X 2/2s, X = life gained this turn), Ajani Resolute 'dream' payoff; the WG prepared spell gains only 1; Vigorbloom Charm is the best partner.
LLU #261: Germinate Recruits made 6+ tokens in the right deck despite F/D- stats.
Set reviews: Unflinching Hortimancer with the WG prepared spell (two counters a turn); Greenhouse Propagator curves into Bloombrute.
LLU #258: Lyra, Archangel of Dawn counters every Angel; pair with Blossom-Blessed Angel.
